name: getWeather
description: Get current weather for the user or a named place. Call this before answering any weather, temperature, rain, or umbrella question. Never guess weather numbers. If the user names a place, pass location. If they ask generally, omit location to use their saved city or timezone. Read the summary field from the response aloud.

request_body_schema.description: Fetch weather for the current user or a named city/town.

location.description: Optional city or place when the user asks about weather somewhere specific, for example Prague, Brno, Miami, or Tokyo. Omit when they ask about local weather without naming a place.
